vo.en: Break a hundred-dollar bill right now.

visual.description: Close up shot of masculine hands pulling a crisp brand-new hundred dollar bill out of a sleek dark leather wallet.

vo.en: You feel an immediate sting of pain, yet five twenty-dollar bills feel like worthless paper.

visual.description: High angle dynamic shot of crumpled twenty dollar bills tossed carelessly onto a dark wooden table.

vo.en: Economists call this the denomination effect. Your brain treats large single notes as protected treasure.

visual.description: Glowing three-dimensional digital model of a human brain with firing golden neural pathways and data graphics.

vo.en: But here is the truly sinister trap waiting inside your mind.

visual.description: Cinematic tracking shot behind a solitary man standing before a brightly lit glowing vending machine on a dark night.

vo.en: Once you crack that hundred for a two-dollar coffee, your brain writes off the rest as already spent.

visual.description: Dark espresso pouring into a ceramic cup on a stainless steel cafe bar next to loose coins.

vo.en: The psychological barrier vanishes, and you recklessly blow the change on impulse junk before sunset.

visual.description: Fast-moving supermarket checkout conveyor belt carrying snacks and soda past a red laser scanner.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test, comment the dumbest impulse buy you made, and think twice before you

visual.description: Macro close-up shot of massive steel bank vault gears smoothly rotating and locking into place.
